name: MetricCard
intent: A single key-metric tile: a label, a large value (with optional unit), an optional subtitle, a trend arrow + label, and a leading icon — the reusable KPI tile dashboards lay out in rows or grids.
when: Show one headline metric prominently (workforce, safety score, completion %, etc.)
Build a KPI row/grid above a dashboard, list, or chart
You were about to hand-roll a Card with a number, label, and trend
whenNot: Several metrics packed into one compact bar -> use KPISummary (a row of MetricCards / compact items)
A full record's labeled fields -> use PropertyList
A metric that needs a chart, not a number -> use Chart / CoreChartRenderer

chooseOver.because: Card is a generic container; MetricCard is the opinionated metric tile (value + trend + status tone + icon) so dashboards don't re-implement it each time.

title.note: Metric label shown above the value.

dataContract.note: Presentational and stateless — the caller computes/aggregates the number; MetricCard only renders it. No data fetching.

trend.note: Renders a colored arrow (green up / red down / muted stable).

trendLabel.note: Text beside the trend arrow (e.g. "+12% vs target").

icon.note: Leading icon (lucide or any component type).

status.note: Tones the VALUE green/amber/red. Independent of trend (direction).

states.default: Label, value, and (if provided) unit; icon tile on the right.
states.with-trend: trend / trendLabel render a colored arrow + text under the value.
states.status: status tones the value text (success/warning/danger); does not change the trend arrow.
states.minimal: Only title + value provided — subtitle, trend, icon, and status all omit cleanly.

allowedPlacement: KPI row / grid above a dashboard
inside a content region as a metric tile
forbiddenPlacement: packing multiple metrics into one card (use several MetricCards / KPISummary)

commonMistakes.mistake: Passing a raw unformatted number expecting MetricCard to format it
commonMistakes.fix: Pre-format the value (toLocaleString / units) before passing it.

commonMistakes.mistake: Cramming several metrics into one MetricCard
commonMistakes.symptom: A crowded tile that breaks the grid rhythm
commonMistakes.fix: One metric per card; lay out several with a grid or the KPISummary widget.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using status and trend to mean the same thing
commonMistakes.fix: status = value tone (good/bad); trend = direction (up/down). Use each for its own signal.

evaluationCriteria.check: MetricCard chosen for a single metric tile — not Card (generic), DataTable (records), or KPISummary (a row of metrics).
title and value both provided; value is pre-formatted.
trend is up/down/stable; status is success/warning/danger; no unknown props.
Renders a Card with label + value; optional unit/subtitle/trend/icon render only when provided.
